node.statement: Assume U is a nonempty proper subset of C and fix exactly one reset state v_U:M_{|U|}->A_U with recorded epsilon_U=W.L*epsilon and the two required bounds. Choose j in C minus U and put R=U union {j}, epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon, and t_2:=W.K2*epsilon. Since U and j lie in the hypothesized single equivalence class, and nodes 1.1.2-1.1.3 supply epsilon <= W.e_s2/W.K2, the target corner A_R, all scale inequalities, and the required W coefficient conditions, lem-maincb-stage2-call-envelope applies to this exact prior state v_U and furnishes the explicit Stage-2 EXT raw-call datum in A_R with total defect at most C_s2^0*t_2.
